name: alex-act-core
description: The Alex ACT baseline runtime plugin. Installs 30 reusable framework skills and 14 slash-command prompts covering epistemic discipline, continuity semantics, security and privacy, tooling awareness, and engineering craft. Core authors 16 instructions; Manager owns lifecycle, greeting check-in, continuity operations, and the mixed-source instruction bootstrap. Document Tools owns conversion. Eight Core commands remain temporary namespaced redirects.
